item.title: Gwangbok-ro Winter Light Tree Festival 2026 (Dec 4 – Jan 31): Lighting Hours, Nearest Subway Station & December Show Dates
item.description: The 2026 Gwangbok-ro Winter Light Tree Festival (광복로 겨울빛 트리축제) runs from Friday, December 4, 2026 to Sunday, January 31, 2027 on Gwangbok-ro (광복로) and Gwangbokjungang-ro (광복중앙로) in Jung-gu, Busan. The lights are on from 17:30 to 22:30. The festival takes over the main shopping street of Nampo-dong (남포동), so there are no tickets and nothing to book. Get off at Nampo Station (남포역) on Subway Line 1 and walk in. The details below come from the festival listing and official poster on Visit Busan, the city’s official tourism portal, checked on November 27, 2026.
